The total carrying amount of goodwill for all periods in the table above is reflected net of $1.557 billion of

(2)

measurement period, which were not significant to our previously reported operating results or financial
condition.
(3)

which accounted for most of the 2017 goodwill related to acquisitions, see note 3 to our consolidated
financial statements.
